hohmann_dv_leo_tmi_kms.note: Circular-coplanar Hohmann 1.000->1.52368 AU, departure v_inf 2.945 km/s, burn from 300 km circular LEO = 3.590 km/s (200 km: 3.611, 400 km: 3.569). Textbooks (Curtis Ch.8, Vallado) and the Wikipedia delta-v budget quote ~3.6 km/s. +/-0.08 covers LEO altitudes 150-500 km and rounding; not a matter of source disagreement.

hohmann_tof_days.note: Half-period of transfer ellipse a=1.26184 AU: 258.87 d. Curtis Example 8.x quotes ~259 d; some texts use Mars a=1.52 AU (257-259 d) -> +/-3 d.

c3_min_2026_km2s2.note: Global minimum ballistic C3 for the 2026 opportunity (Type II, depart 2026-10-31, arrive 2027-08-19). Computed with DE421 + Lambert (refs/data/p-transfer.porkchop.py) because NTRS/JPL were network-blocked; this method is what Burke/Falck/McGuire's MIDAS tables use. Solver reproduces InSight 8.19 (8.20) and MSL 10.78 (10.60 one day later). Type I minimum is 10.42 (2026-11-12, 272 d). +/-0.5 allows ephemeris/date-grid differences but rejects the Type I value.

tof_2026_days.note: TOF at the 2026 min-C3 point. The C3 valley is flat: C3 within 0.5 km2/s2 of minimum spans TOF 276-342 d, so TOF is weakly determined; +/-25 d. Type I min-C3 TOF 272 d is just outside.

leo_tmi_dv_2026_kms.note: sqrt(C3 + 2 mu_E/r) - sqrt(mu_E/r) from 300 km circular LEO with C3=9.18 -> 3.613 km/s (200 km: ~3.63). Impulsive, no gravity loss, no plane-change/launch-declination penalty. +/-0.1 covers altitude choice and C3 tolerance.

vinf_arrival_2026_kms.note: Arrival hyperbolic excess speed at the 2026 min-C3 point. Over the near-min-C3 region (C3<min+0.5) v_inf ranges 2.56-3.12 km/s; Type I min-C3 gives 2.92. +/-12% (~0.33 km/s).

mars_entry_speed_2026_kms.note: Inertial speed at entry interface r=3396.2+125 km: sqrt(vinf^2 + 2*42828.37/r) with vinf=2.72. Atmosphere-relative speed is ~0.2 km/s lower (planet rotation), and EI altitude conventions (125-130 km) matter little. Sanity: MSL ~5.8-5.9 km/s (vinf ~3.5), Perseverance ~5.4-5.6. +/-0.3.

c3_min_2028_km2s2.note: 2028 opportunity: Type II min 8.995 (dep 2028-11-29, TOF 315 d); Type I min 9.024 (dep 2028-12-10, TOF 222 d) essentially equal, so either type passes. Same method/caveat as 2026.

c3_min_2031_km2s2.note: 2031 opportunity: Type II min 8.170 (dep 2031-02-22, TOF 320 d); Type I min 8.97 (dep 2031-01-27, 190 d). Note high arrival v_inf (~5.5 km/s) in 2031. Same method/caveat as 2026.

synodic_period_days.note: 1/(1/365.256 - 1/686.980) = 779.94 d (NASA Mars fact sheet lists synodic period 779.94 d). Precise; +/-1.5 d only for rounding of sidereal periods.
